name: Tolerance
overview: Scripture calls believers to exercise discernment and love in their interactions with others, warning against tolerating sin even within close relationships, as seen in Deuteronomy 13:6. At the same time, Christ teaches restraint in judgment, reminding us that only those without sin may rightly condemn (John 8:7) and encouraging us to treat others as we desire to be treated (Matthew 7:12). Pleasant and gracious speech is commended for its healing power (Proverbs 16:24), but justifying the wicked or condemning the righteous is detestable to God (Proverbs 17:15), underscoring that true tolerance does not mean approving all behavior but balancing truth with mercy.
